purpose: Abstract capabilities the aha patterns need, each with candidate terms. compat_check looks for the candidates (case-insensitive, exact) among every key and string value in the real schema, vocabulary and contract files, and records which term matched. The candidates come from the project dev log and are guesses until compat_check confirms them. Edit this file, never the code, when the engine's names differ.
